messages:
Alex Chen: quick sync — ran async-prefill prototype against a quantized candidate on a small fleet.
Mira Patel: nice, what was the patch?
Alex Chen: enabled prefill shadowing: warm first 64 tokens in a background worker, then attach KV when ready. code:
```
prefill_worker.start(batch_size=16, warm_tokens=64, mode='async_attach')
```
Jon S: did you change batching behavior?
Alex Chen: kept the primary batcher unchanged; worker uses opportunistic microbatches so no backpressure.
Priya K: latency numbers?
Alex Chen: median p50 gen latency down ~11% for short prompts (<=128 tokens), throughput +1.5x on synthetic microload. p95 slightly up for some tails (~+70ms) when attach delayed.
Mira Patel: how about quality/regression?
Alex Chen: ran our 1k eval prompts (mix of instruction + longform). BLEU-ish proxy unchanged; however we saw a subtle hallucination uptick on knowledge-retrieval subset (precision drop ~2.2%).
Mira Patel: can you share repro?
Alex Chen: pasted eval command and sample diff:
```
python eval_onboard.py --model=q4_async --prompts=data/knowledge_set.jsonl --seed=42 --output=out.jsonl
# sample diff: expected: '2003', got: '2001' on prompt id 324
```
Jon S: ops note: memory spike on attach in warmup, doubled transient GPU mem for a few batches.
Priya K: unsafe for Dedicated defaults then. need guardrails.
Alex Chen: agreed. plan: add attach-timeout (fall back to sync decode after 200ms), dynamic_warm_len per workload, and run larger holdout.
Mira Patel: can we run a randomized A/B with traffic shaping? want to see real-world regression rate.
Alex Chen: will run 10k A/B on staging next week, track precision/recall on retrieval set + latency distributions.
ops-bot: deploy: canary started on staging (job id dj-8732)
Priya K: also add metric for attach-failure-rate and KV-stitch-latency.
Alex Chen: noted. will post results in this thread. thanks :thumbsup:
